judgment: It is good to set up lords
image: Thunder rises out of earth: Delight.
So the early kings made music and great offerings,
honouring virtue, presenting to the god on high,
in matching sacrifice to the ancestors.
lines: He is firm as a rock,
and does not wait out the day.
If he looks up in delight: regret.
If he is slow, there will be regret.
From delight at its source: great gain.
Friends gather like hair under a clasp.
he is long ill, but he does not die.

notes.name_en: 豫 is ease/delight (and readiness); 'Delight', not Wilhelm's 'Enthusiasm'.
notes.image: 殷薦/配祖考: full offerings matched to the ancestors; 祖考 compressed to 'the ancestors'.
notes.L4: 盍簪 hair gathered under a clasp-pin, friends likewise.
